'''Simento-Threk''' was a celestial body<ref name="Monsters">''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]''</ref> located in the [[Simento-Threk system/Legends|Simento-Threk system]], a part of the [[Meram sector/Legends|Meram sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA Simento-Threk" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Simento-Threk was first mentioned in the [[1993]] book ''[[Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas]]'', a publication that combines creature designs and photographs from various projects of [[George Lucas]], creator of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' franchise, with original text by [[Bob Carrau]]. In the book, Simento-Threk was introduced as the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[mOKDAR 15]], the [[Alien/Legends|alien]] [[Director of Nasal Infusions]] at [[Regalia Sub-space station-12]] and member of the [[Society for the Refusal of Astrophysics]].<ref name="Monsters" />

[[Lucasfilm]] employee [[Leland Chee]], who maintains the [[Holocron continuity database]], has indicated that information contained in ''Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas'' is [[Canon|non-canonical]] with respect to the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="Chee">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=690#14724917|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-05-03|time=5:45 PM|quote=And is information from Monsters and Aliens from George Lucas canon? Unless referred to by a source that is in-continuity, the information is non-continuity.}}</ref> However, [[Jason Fry]],<ref name="Fry">{{PlanetSystemNames}}</ref> co-author of the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'',<ref name="TEA Simento-Threk" /> has [[:File:JasonFryAtlas.png|stated]] that the [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] listed in the book's Appendix section are named after the most prominent [[Planet/Legends|planets]] or celestial bodies located in those systems. This article therefore considers the existence of Simento-Threk to be canonical with respect to the Legends continuity.<ref name="Fry" /> ''The Essential Atlas'' placed the Simento-Threk system, and therefore Simento-Threk, in grid square O-4.<ref name="TEA Simento-Threk" />
